description: This Java class defines BOMNode, representing a component in a bill of materials within the manufacturing module of Apache OFBiz. It includes methods for loading children and parent nodes, substitution logic, manufacturing order creation, and various utility functions related to BOM processing.

classes.name: BOMNode
classes.description: Represents a node in a bill of materials, with methods for managing BOM structure, substitutions, manufacturing orders, and related utilities.

methods.name: loadChildren
methods.description: Loads child nodes based on product associations, applying configuration rules and handling different BOM types.

methods.name: substituteNode
methods.description: Performs substitution of a BOM node based on product features and manufacturing rules.

methods.name: configurator
methods.description: Configures a BOM node, handling virtual parts, substitutions, and product variants.

methods.name: loadParents
methods.description: Loads parent nodes in the BOM structure.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Calculates the earliest start date for manufacturing based on BOM nodes and proposed orders.

methods.name: isWarehouseManaged
methods.description: Determines if the product is managed in a warehouse, based on product facilities.

methods.name: isManufactured
methods.description: Checks if the product is considered manufactured, considering supplier products and child nodes.

methods.name: isVirtual
methods.description: Checks if the product is virtual based on its attribute.

methods.name: isConfigured
methods.description: Recursively checks if the BOM node is configured.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints the BOM structure for debugging or display purposes.

methods.name: getProductsInPackages
methods.description: Collects products that are in shipment packages.

methods.name: sumQuantity
methods.description: Aggregates quantities of products in the BOM structure.

methods.name: createManufacturingOrder
methods.description: Creates manufacturing orders and related production runs for the BOM node and its children.
